text: MODULE RESOLUTION (lang-forms LF-4): `mod util` now also searches the entry file's own directory, LAST, after AXON_PATH, ~/.axon/lib and <bindir>/../lib/axon, so every module found before is still found first and only a program that failed with E0901 changes. The entry directory is never searched under AXON_PATH_EXCLUSIVE=1, while sealing, or when it is group- or world-writable, the system temp directory, or unreadable; E0901 names a skipped one with the reason. check, run, build (and its cache key), lock, the @[contained] import-edge check and the LSP all use the same list; session cells and axon-os jobs are unchanged.
